100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On September 6, 1926, the United States marked its ongoing recovery from the Great Depression, with discussions intensifying around economic policies to boost growth. In Europe, tensions continued to rise as the League of Nations faced challenges in addressing the ongoing strife in the Ruhr region of Germany. Meanwhile, in the world of entertainment, the film "The General" starring Buster Keaton received praise for its innovative comedic style, underscoring the era's fascination with cinema.
